text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That was close. I very nearly yawned in your presence…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I beg your pardon. Lately, I have been finding it difficult to fall asleep at night.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My brain starts churning out multiple variations of different schedules the moment I lay down.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Once presented with these options, I start pondering which version is the most efficient, and… Urgh… Here I go, thinking about them again…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Eishin Flash hasn't been getting much rest recently…
